correctness.rationale: Exact five-case conditional calculation gives all matrix entries. For each n≥3 direct multiplication of explicit lower and upper bidiagonal factors gives M; their diagonal product gives det 1/[3^{n−2}(n−1)!]; triangular inverse formula gives each inverse entry as a positive finite sum, including the n=3 boundary. Checker performs 1,167 exact rational assertions, exhaustive permutations n=3..8, LU n=3..34, inverse n=3..13. Finite assertions are not treated as the unrestricted proof.

originality.rationale: A position-indexed record–peak cross-covariance law, bidiagonal factorization, determinant, and strict inverse positivity were not stated by the materially inspected primary record and peak papers or closest published findings. Ji (arXiv:2310.01053, Theorems 1.4 and 3.1) treats joint *aggregate* record and peak statistics and is the strongest relevant comparison, but does not mark individual record and peak positions; aggregate enumeration cannot recover an arbitrary full position-indexed covariance matrix without additional information. Finite explicit calculations support but do not certify originality. An implicit earlier derivation in a more general position-marked model remains possible.
residual_risks: A more general, uninspected position-marked joint record–peak enumeration could imply all formulas; priority not independently certified.

value.rationale: Upper-record (prefix-global) and local-peak (three-point) indicators are basic order statistics; their entire cross-covariance matrix governs linear detectability of one family through the other. Full rank for all sizes and a strictly positive inverse are nontrivial joint structure not recoverable from their separate marginal probabilities or scalar count covariances. The result provides an exact, natural all-size classification and constructive nondegeneracy, not an arbitrary finite table.
